# Market Bubble Search

> A search engine over 1,187 hours of crypto podcasts, live broadcasts and
> long-form interviews. Ask a question in plain English and it answers only
> from the transcripts, quoting the speaker and citing the exact second it
> was said. If the archive does not contain the answer, it says so instead
> of inventing one.

Built and run by one person. Live, free, no login, at
https://search.lexthedev.com

An AnsemHack Clawrena entry. Token $MBS on ClawPump, mint
8VjFid8BVGcTPpUzf4PAWsA5nHJ5h2GQNXPEjyr2mF7t

## What is indexed

Four archives, kept in separate namespaces so an answer about one show can
never be sourced from another.

- Market Bubble: 21 shows, 73.4 hours. The live X broadcast with Ansem
  (@blknoiz06) and FaZe Banks. About a quarter of each live show never
  reaches the YouTube upload, so for those minutes this is the only
  searchable copy that exists.
- MCG Live: 651 episodes, 1,039.9 hours, one project per episode, current
  to 26 September 2026. 388 episodes carry named guests, 614 people.
- Elon Musk: 14 long-form interviews, 37.8 hours, 2018 to 2026. Rogan, Lex
  Fridman, the Economist, and the 2024 X space with Trump.
- The Record: 30 finance recordings, 36 hours, 2014 to 2026. Larry Fink,
  Ray Dalio, Jerome Powell, Jamie Dimon, Cathie Wood, Stephen Schwarzman,
  Michael Saylor, Raoul Pal.

Total: 716 recordings, 1,187 hours.

Also indexed: 2,853 vectors of Ansem's own posts, and asset indexes of
every token, stock and index the shows discussed, ranked by how deeply
each was covered and linked to the moment it came up. 2,121 assets across
MCG, 374 across Market Bubble.

## Inference

Every model call runs through UsePod. /v1/stats reports
inference.proxy_share, which reads 1.0 on 0 direct calls. Answering is
claude-haiku-4-5 behind voyage-3.5 embeddings and rerank-2.5-lite, chosen
because retrieval does the work and answers are short. Model choice is one
setting per job, which is how the whole service moved onto UsePod without
touching the pipeline.

This is the AnsemHack Inference Markets track entry: the inference is not
a line item, it is what answers a stranger's question in public, for free,
with a citation.

## What it refuses to do

Measured on a 181-question bank: 165 answered correctly. The number that
matters more is the refusals. It declines 19 of the 21 questions the
archive does not cover, and 28 of 28 attempts to bait it into inventing
an answer. When the archive does not contain something it says "I
couldn't find that in the archive" rather than citing an unrelated
timestamp, because search always returns its top matches whether or not
the answer is in them.

Attribution follows the same rule. Voices are fingerprinted per segment,
and when a question asks what one person said, only that person's lines
are passed to the model, so it cannot attribute a line it never saw. An
unlabelled line is marked as unattributed rather than assigned to
whoever else is in the passage.

Answers carry no financial advice, and every claim carries the second it
was said so it can be checked against the recording.

## Clips

Any moment can be cut and captioned from the archive, at the source
resolution, with captions taken from the same Whisper transcript the
search runs on rather than from auto-generated subtitles, so project
names and tickers survive.

## How an episode becomes searchable

1. Transcribe with Whisper, locally on MLX or hosted on Groq. Works on X
   broadcasts, which carry no captions at all.
2. Chunk into roughly 2,400-character passages that keep their timestamps,
   and embed each one.
3. Search by meaning, rerank, and answer only from the passages returned.
4. Fingerprint voices so the answer knows who said it, and refuse to
   attribute a line rather than guess.
5. Verify: the last step asks the live index about the new episode. It is
   not considered ingested until it can be found.

## Pages

- https://search.lexthedev.com/ : Market Bubble, the broadcast
- https://search.lexthedev.com/mcg : MCG Live
- https://search.lexthedev.com/elon : the Musk interviews
- https://search.lexthedev.com/finance : The Record, finance on tape
- https://search.lexthedev.com/mcg/assets : every asset MCG discussed
- https://search.lexthedev.com/demo/assets.html : every asset Market Bubble discussed

## API

All POST, JSON body {"query": "..."}, no key required.

- https://search.lexthedev.com/v1/podcast/search
- https://search.lexthedev.com/v1/mcg/search
- https://search.lexthedev.com/v1/elon/search
- https://search.lexthedev.com/v1/finance/search

Archive summaries, GET: /v1/podcast/archive, /v1/mcg/archive,
/v1/elon/archive, /v1/finance/archive
Service health, GET: /x-bot/status and /v1/stats

## Distribution

@mbubbleSearch on X answers questions in public, under other people's
posts, citing the archive with a timestamp. Ansem has reposted it
unprompted and has replied to it directly. Every reply is checked against
the transcript, and the speaker confirmed on camera, before it goes out.
